bibliographic.title: [ MAKE ME. ]
bibliographic.author: kaijuCrow
bibliographic.description:
A FREE Twine demo written in Harlowe 3.3.8.
Originally developed for Queer Vampire Game Jam and Smoochie Jam in February 2024. 
This is my first try at a game written in Twine! Enjoy the shenanigans as I continue to work on the narrative and drive myself insane figuring out logistics. Will be updated once I've had my post-jam chill time!
I'd like to give a shoutout to Ethersic for their fangtastic game, Through Death We Become! I was inspired to join the Vamp Jam after playing it (despite my preference for werewolves). Please go try it out!

PLANNED FEATURES:
  • Dynamic Protagonist with customizable traits, clothing style, gender, and more.
  • 3 Main Story routes—Vampire, Human, or Vampire Hunter.
  • 3 Romanceable gender-selectable characters (Or just be friends; that’s cool too).
  • more than the current bite-sized 4,000 words.
  • terrible vampire puns

CONTENT WARNINGS:
  • Blood
  • Violence
  • Mature Language
  • Sexual themes/innuendo
  • Religious references

Attributions:
